terbaru.judul: Game theory models for communication between agents: a review
terbaru.pelajaran: Here in this paper, we present a comprehensive multidisciplinary state-of-the-art review and taxonomy of game theory models of complex interactions between agents.

terbaru.judul: Agent based simulation of the evolution of society as an alternate maximization problem
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a very realistic setting, where we design a joint alternate maximization step algorithm to maximize a certain \textit{fitness} function, which we believe simulates the way societies develop.

terbaru.judul: Cyber Defense as a Complex Adaptive System: A model-based approach to strategic policy design
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a model to explore the socio-technical dynamics of these systems, discuss lessons using this platform, and suggest further research and development.

terbaru.judul: On the predictability of infectious disease outbreaks
terbaru.pelajaran: To investigate the question of outbreak prediction, we study the information theoretic limits to forecasting across a broad set of infectious diseases using permutation entropy as a model independent measure of predictability.

terbaru.judul: A Music-generating System Inspired by the Science of Complex Adaptive Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper presents NetWorks (NW), an interactive music generation system that uses a hierarchically clustered scale free network to generate music that ranges from orderly to chaotic.

terbaru.judul: When Big Data Fails! Relative success of adaptive agents using coarse-grained information to compete for limited resources
terbaru.pelajaran: Using a model complex adaptive system where agents compete for a limited resource using information coarse-grained to different levels, we show that agents having access to more and better data can perform worse than others in certain situations.

terbaru.judul: Instantaneous Modelling and Reverse Engineering of DataConsistent Prime Models in Seconds!
terbaru.pelajaran: A theoretical framework that supports automated construction of dynamic prime models purely from experimental time series data has been invented and developed, which can automatically generate (construct) data-driven models of any time series data in seconds.

terbaru.judul: Comparison of Selection Methods in On-line Distributed Evolutionary Robotics
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we study the impact of selection methods in the context of on-line on-board distributed evolutionary algorithms.

terbaru.judul: Time Evolution of Non-linear Currency Networks
terbaru.pelajaran: In this study we look at the currency markets by creating networks which can account for non-linearity in the underlying relationships, and are based on short time horizons with the use of running window approach.

terbaru.judul: Emergent "Quantum" Theory in Complex Adaptive Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: Motivated by the question of stability, in this letter we argue that an effective "quantum" theory can emerge in complex adaptive systems.
